title: Aspell 2010 · own body visible
citation: Aspell, J. E., Lavanchy, T., Lenggenhager, B., & Blanke, O. (2010). Seeing the body modulates audiotactile integration. European Journal of Neuroscience, 31(10), 1868–1873.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.apparatus: Four sound locations at upper/lower back height, to the left or right. Physical loudspeakers sit 60 cm laterally from the body; the visible fake loudspeakers are distinct props.
published_method.response: Classify back vibration as upper or lower with a two-button box, ignoring sound and side. Exclude incorrect trials and RT above 1500 ms.
published_method.design: Compare the effect of auditory–tactile elevation congruency in paired trials. Audio location and tactile target vary independently. Each formal trial has touch, so it has no blank catches or separate tactile-only baseline.
published_method.body_visibility: Live rear video of the participant wearing four fake speakers, captured from 2 m away; view hides the real sound sources.

source_provenance.value: White noise delivered by an active speaker at one of four positions.
source_provenance.gap: No original waveform, sample rate or noise synthesis settings.

auditory_conditions.value: Four physical positions crossed independently with four tactile positions, generating same/different side and congruent/incongruent elevation.

gain_envelope.gap: Measurement location, frequency weighting, ramp and delivered exposure not stated. This is the authors' reported number.

value.speaker: Velleman MLS 3 2W, 8 Ω, 66 mm
value.visual_feedback: HMD with rear camera 2 m behind or pre-recorded image

trial_rows_families.value: Each formal trial has one white-noise distractor then one vibrotactile elevation target.

condition_intermixing.value: Speaker and vibrator independently randomized across trials.
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact per-cell balance, seed and constraints unknown.

value.repositioning: Speakers moved between blocks as needed.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Number of repeats of each condition block is not explicit.

response_window.gap: The online timeout and no-response scheduling behavior are not established.

task_sequence_rules.value: Right hand chooses one of two buttons for upper or lower vibration, regardless of side. Ignore sound.

tactile_stimulus.gap: Exact motor model for this study, waveform, amplitude and delivered timing not stated.

baseline_strategy.value: Formal trials all pair audio and touch. Body-hidden and congruent comparisons are experimental conditions, not unimodal baselines.

catch_trial_type.value: Each formal trial includes a tactile target.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Independent randomization and block size do not establish counts for each speaker-by-motor pairing.

block_count.gap: Condition set and 80 trials per block are stated. Exact number of blocks is not explicit.

total_trial_count.gap: Exact block repetition and total count unknown.

implementation_gaps: Requires the source body-visibility video conditions, reproducible HMD image alignment and latency, a four-position physical loudspeaker rig and four independently calibrated skin stimulators.
The publication's reported 120 dB value has no sufficient calibration reference for playback; it is provenance only. Never use it as an executable level.
The paper does not specify per-configuration repetitions, a measured tactile waveform, original source settings, or the online response deadline.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
